description: This Java source file defines a class `DummyMiddleware` that implements the `CommandMiddleware` interface, used for processing commands in a command processing pattern. It is part of a package related to command handling within the Apache Fineract project, specifically for sample middleware demonstrating command processing.

classes.name: DummyMiddleware
classes.description: A command middleware that sets the payload ID of `DummyCommand` instances to match the command ID.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes a command; if the command is an instance of DummyCommand, sets its payload's ID to the command's ID.
